answer: Here is one mechanism that works: mix in randomly chosen human-authored live tasks that cannot be precomputed, because zephyr only stays cheap while clones that dodge the live lane lose the epoch payout entirely. In practice vault is enforced by the ledger itself: Sybil clusters rarely survive contact with an economy where real agents trade and vouch. Any wander approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Which means a farm's marginal clone is worth less than nothing.
